sync_pending: Progress: on this device only, will upload later
foot_repeat: Repetition by card count: "Wrong" returns after about 20 cards, "Partly" after 50, "almost" after 100, "known" after 250. A new card answered right goes straight to "almost". While new cards remain, two new ones come, then one repetition. "Later" pushes a card back by 30 cards.
foot_box: Tap a box (new, shaky, almost, known) to go through every card of that box once, most important first. Tap again to stop.
foot_dictate: Dictate an answer: tap the field, then use the keyboard microphone. "Check" grades only against the model answer from your notes.
foot_listen: Listen mode: reads the question, waits the thinking pause, reads the answer. With "Answer by voice" a beep follows: say "yes", "partly" or "no" - also "again", "later", "stop". A low double tone means not understood: tap instead. "Pause" stops at once, "Resume" continues with this card. Keep the screen on.
hist_btn: History: review and correct recent grades
hist_empty: No grades in the history yet.
reset_none: There is no progress to reset here ({where}).
reset_warn: Warning: the progress of {n} cards will be lost ({where}). They go back to "new".
walk_info: Walking through box "{name}" - {open} of {total} cards left.
report_placeholder: What is wrong? E.g. unclear question, wrong answer, not exam-relevant …
report_empty: Please describe briefly what is wrong.
report_nodb: No database connection - please report in the chat.
report_saved: Saved. Claude sees the note once you say "process notes" in the chat.
report_failed: Saving failed - please report in the chat.
tts_unsupported: Reading aloud is not supported in this browser.
ai_incomplete: The grading came back incomplete. Compare with the model answer yourself.
ai_unavailable: AI grading is not available here. Compare with the model answer yourself.
ai_rate: Too many requests right now or your usage limit is reached. Compare yourself, it works again later.
ai_login: Please sign in to claude.ai again, then grading works again.
ai_failed: Grading did not work. Compare with the model answer yourself.
hoer_say: Say now: yes, partly or no …
hoer_mic_off: The microphone is not available here - please tap.
hoer_novoice: This browser has no speech input - listen mode still works, by tapping.
